prompt: What Mozilla Firefox release version included the patch note: "Improved the performance of the instance when Microsoft's IME and Defender retrieve the URL of a focused document in Windows 11 version 22H2"?
answer: The patch note was included in **Mozilla Firefox 107.0**, released on **November 15, 2022**.
